evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call would take about maybe, 71015 minutes Max. And you can walk away with a quote that you can depend on, sounds good. [Customer affirms.]
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Christopher Hampton. Move: Austin to McKinney (Dallas area). Date: Sunday October 11th. Size: 800 sq ft, 2 bedrooms.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Other than the price obviously, what are your biggest concerns about the move-in any answers that you want, any questions one answers to you on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises concern about expensive monitors/computer equipment. Rep follows: 'Is that something, I'll have to disassemble or will you all be able to take care of that?' Customer raises scheduling concern. Rep follows with On-Time Guarantee details.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: So what I'm hearing is Christopher you need full packing service. Of course all of the materials or furniture and the monitors needs to be padded. Did I get all of it?
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Property type (townhome), stories (two), bedrooms (two), parking (open lot with covered area, 5-6 steps), no extra rooms/garage, no oversized items, no fragile items, no appliances, box count (22-30 boxes typical for size).
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Full packing service requested and acknowledged.
evidence_quotes.box_count: So for a home of your size supposed to give you a reference there's typically about 2230 pre pack boxes. Do you think you fall within the range?
evidence_quotes.two_promises_on_time: When we book your move Christopher, we'll lock in a firm arrival window for you and if ever relate $50 comes up immediately after the first hour it's an extra $25 for every thirty minutes after that.
evidence_quotes.two_promises_damage: Up to $2,000 included in the hourly rate and we pay it out in four to six day.
evidence_quotes.section4_gap: Rep says 'I've got everything I need here Christopher, let me just build your estimate. Can I give you a callback right after like, five to ten minutes.' No estimate anchor given, no pricing framing, no 'does that feel fair' asked.
evidence_quotes.section6_gap: Call ends with callback promise. No 'what's still concerning you' check, no catch-all, no final concerns gate.
evidence_quotes.section7_gap: Call ends mid-pitch without ever asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' No explicit ask, no rate-lock mention, no booking confirmation.

top_strength: Danah executed a flawless Section 2 (Their Concerns): asked the agenda early, followed up authentically when the customer raised the monitors concern and scheduling logistics, and reflected back all concerns with clear confirmation before moving forward.
coaching_note: The call halts at the callback for estimate calculation — Sections 4, 5, 6, and 7 (pricing, promises, final concerns, and the ask itself) were never delivered; confirm whether this was intentional per company protocol or a dropped handoff, and if intentional, clarify when those sections resume on the callback.
